by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission results site: an election's overall official result

landmarks: headers Party Votes, % of Votes, Electorate Seats, List Seats, Total seats

signals_note: The index page of an election's results. The election's front page prints the same report and is held, not read.
notes: The Commission's own count of seats per party at the official result: the lane's outside check for who was elected. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
applies_to: electionresults.govt.nz, as captured by the old estate's results job under var/staging/ec-results/pages/ (index.html)
process: One row per party; '-' is none.
The Total row is the seat count of the House at the return.
gates: Every party row reads to integers or '-'.
The parties' seats add to the Total row.
on_fail: publish nothing from the page; a catch-log line

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission results site: electorate status (leading and second candidate, with party abbreviations)

landmarks: per electorate: 'Leading Candidate:' NAME (ABBR), '2nd Candidate:' NAME (ABBR), 'Margin:'

notes: Read for one thing: the abbreviation the Commission prints beside a candidate it names in full on the electorate page, so an abbreviation on a by-election page can be read back to a party name from the Commission's own pairing. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
applies_to: electionresults.govt.nz, as captured by the old estate's results job under var/staging/ec-results/pages/ (electorate-status.html)
process: Pair each (name, abbreviation) with the same name's party on that election's electorate page.
gates: An abbreviation paired to two party names is not used.

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission results site: successful candidates (who was elected, by party, list or electorate)

landmarks: an <h3> party heading row, then rows NAME | 'List Seat' or a link '<Electorate> Electorate' to electorate-details-NN.html

successful_candidates_table: seat: 'List Seat' or the electorate, linked to its page number

notes: Who the official result returned, as at the return: not later list replacements or by-elections. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
applies_to: electionresults.govt.nz, as captured by the old estate's results job under var/staging/ec-results/pages/ (successful-candidates.html)
process: A heading row opens a party; every row after it is that party's member until the next heading.
gates: Every candidate row falls under a party heading.
Each party's electorate and list counts equal the overall result's.

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission results site: one electorate's official result (candidate votes, party votes, totals)
signals_note: One page per electorate, numbered 01-72 in the order of the site's electorate list. '(poll cancelled)' after a name marks an electorate poll cancelled by a candidate's death (Port Waikato 2023).

partyCandidatesResultsTable: the candidate's party as printed, and that party's party votes in the electorate (empty for an independent, or a party not seeking the party vote)
rows after the candidates: parties with no candidate in the electorate: party and party votes

notes: A candidate row pairs the candidate with the party they stood for: the Commission prints the candidate's party beside them. The page prints its own totals, so every page is scored: candidate votes plus candidate informals equal the candidate TOTAL. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
applies_to: electionresults.govt.nz, as captured by the old estate's results job under var/staging/ec-results/pages/ (electorate-details-NN.html)
process: Candidate rows first, then party-only rows.
Votes are digits; totals carry thousands commas.
gates: Candidate votes + candidate informals = candidate TOTAL.
Party votes + party informals = party TOTAL.
on_fail: the page is set aside whole: a page that fails its own total publishes nothing

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission results site: a by-election's official result
notes: Party is printed as an abbreviation; it is read back to a name from the Commission's own pairings (the electorate status pages) where one exists, else kept as printed. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
process: The candidate with the most votes is the member returned.
on_fail: the page is set aside whole

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission: the electorate candidates of a general election (workbook)

sheet1: Party (as registered; 'Independent' or an unregistered party's name)

notes: Published when nominations close. The release that announces it states the counts it must meet. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
applies_to: elections.nz Electorate-Candidates-<year>.xlsx, as held under var/staging/ec-candidate-list/
process: One row per candidate; the sheet row is the place.
gates: Every row has a name and an electorate.
on_fail: the row is a catch-log line

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: vote.nz (the Electoral Commission): each registered party's list, in order

landmarks: an <ol> of 'SURNAME, Given' items under each

accordion: ordered list of candidates: the list place is the item's position

notes: The order is the order list seats are filled in. The Commission's PDF of the same lists is held and its places are compared against this page. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
process: Place = 1 + the item's index in its <ol>.
gates: Each party's count equals the release's list-candidate count for it.

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission: party lists for a general election (PDF, multi-column)

landmarks: PARTY NAME in capitals, then 'N SURNAME, Given' lines in several columns

signals_note: The columns interleave on the text layer, so the party is not readable from layout alone; the place and name pairs are.
notes: Not read for rows: its (place, name) pairs are the cross-check of the vote.nz page's order. A name wrapped onto the next line is a catch-log line, not a difference.
process: Every 'N SURNAME, Given' pair on the text layer.
gates: Every page-list (place, name) is found among the PDF's pairs.
on_fail: a difference fails the lane's check

by: house session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at house-1)
title: Electoral Commission release: candidate and party lists released (the counts)

landmarks: a table whose first row is Registered party | List candidates | Electorate candidates

notes: The Commission's own figures for the nominations: the lane's outside check for candidates. A deterministic read of the page's own markup: no model.
process: The figures are read from the release's own sentences and table, nothing derived.
gates: Every table row reads to two integers.
on_fail: the check reports the figure unread; it never passes on it
